item.title: Germany eyes joining GCAP fighter jet project with U.K, Italy and Japan
item.description: There has been mounting speculation the group could open the door to Germany after a rival Franco-German fighter program collapsed in June.

item.title: Takaichi again in a bind as U.S. threatens to ‘end’ ICC
item.description: Japan, which hosts roughly 60,000 U.S. service members and depends on Washington for its security, will need to walk a fine line as it pushes back.

item.title: More Japanese firms hit by large-scale data breaches
item.description: The companies respectively said that they had found no evidence of unauthorized use of the affected information by third parties.

item.title: Major earthquake hits Panama, injures at least 27
item.description: The shallow tremor was felt across the Central American nation of around 4.5 million people, according to the National Civil Protection System.

item.title: Is iPhone 18 demand cooling off? Here’s how deep Apple reportedly is cutting component orders.
item.description: Component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max are down about 15% in October, according to Nikkei Asia.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
